items.claim: Lasso reads as a click in world units, so a lasso drawn zoomed in or a long thin one clears the selection
items.note: The click test and the vertex spacing are now in screen px. A sliver long on one axis is hit-tested, as the marquee does. I also reworded yesterday's pending `lasso-sliver-reads-as-click` changeset, because it now overstated what counts as a click.

items.claim: Cut deletes the operands but copies the clipboard's own selection; Copy has the same split
items.note: `ClipboardDep.copy(ids?)` is new API, so the changeset is `minor`. `apps/draw`'s wrapped dep now passes the ids through.

items.claim: Make Boolean Group doesn't re-express an envelope operand's children, so they jump
items.note: Swap's `reframed` moved to a shared `actions/reframed.ts`, and swap uses it from there.

items.claim: `useAlign`/`useDistribute` write `setPose` on a derived-pose node, so it doesn't move
items.note: when the hook is given `scene`. The finding's side point, that the hooks skip the actions' lock and page-structure filters, I did not change: the hooks only see an adapter and a `DrawnBoundsScene`, which has no lock reader.

items.claim: Reorder reports enabled with no `scene` dep
Copy and Cut report enabled with no `clipboard` dep
Pathfinder actions check `operands` in `enabled` but combine the adapter's selection
Rotate with `pivot: 'each'` takes a selected derived-pose group apart, unlike Flip
Group (Cmd+G) had the same envelope-children jump as Make Boolean Group (sweep, `edit/group.ts`, which is outside the listed files)
items.note: One assertion in `group.test.ts` changed: a member whose pose doesn't change no longer gets a no-op transform op.

items.claim: Flip reads every node through the base pose descriptor and ignores `forNode`
Flip's `enabled` throws when there are operands but no scene
Make Boolean Group doesn't strip page structure
items.note: `rootsAmong` already runs `withoutPageStructure` (`packages/core/src/interactions/actions/selectionSubtree.ts:14`). A test selecting a page alongside its content passed before any change.

items.claim: Lasso's default commit and `selectFromLasso` answer a degenerate lasso differently
Clone preview hands a singular-frame copy's `null` pose to the quantize rule
items.note: It was worse than reported: the rule threw out of `onMove` on every move.

items.claim: Swap is enabled over an envelope with a locked member, and its commit writes that member
Flip, Align, Distribute, and Rotate write the locked member of a selected envelope
items.note: Before the fix I ran it: Flip, Align, and Swap were each enabled and their `run` threw from the lock guard.

items.claim: Make Boolean Group is enabled for a selection spanning layers, then does nothing
`transformSelection`'s doc says to require `selection`, but it reads `operands`
A clone dropped into another container stores an envelope's children in the source's frame
A lone path-effect node with one source turns about the source's center while the gesture orbits the effect's box
Group sizes its container through the base descriptor too, ignoring `forNode`
Nudge and Transform Again answer enabled with operands but no scene, while their `run` returns at once
items.note: together with flip. One existing nudge test asserted `true` for that case; I dropped that line, and a new test asserts not applicable.

items.claim: Nudge and Transform Again (and through it `transformSelection`) also throw over an envelope with a locked source
A swap drop commits through `swapOps` and threw on the same locked case
items.note: It now refuses the drop. The drop still arms over such a target: it shows the dwell preview, then commits nothing. Not fixed: arming would have to build the swap's ops on every hit-test.
